name: China Resources Power Holdings Company Limited
summary: China Resources Power Holdings Company Limited, an investment holding company, invests in, develops, operates, and manages power plants and coal mine projects in the People's Republic of China. The company operates in two segments, Thermal Power and Renewable Energy. It operates and manages coal- and gas-fired power plants, wind farms, photovoltaic power plants, hydro-electric power plants, and other clean and renewable energy projects. As of December 31, 2025, the company had 50 coal-fired power plants, 221 wind farms, 221 photovoltaic power plants, 20 hydroelectric plants, and 6 gas-fired plants with total attributable grid-connected installed capacity was 89,647MW.
